value.rationale: For every exponent above two the corrected result gives an explicit positive coefficient-sensitive stability gap in an extremal norm-ratio inequality. The previously published coefficient gap stops at r=2. The bound can be integrated over high-exponent intervals and uses an intrinsic Hardy--Dirichlet defect; it is not a restatement of positivity alone.
